title: Apply for the Assisted School Travel Program
summary: Find out if your child, a student with a disability in NSW, can receive travel assistance through the Assisted School Travel Program.
intro:
School students living with disability who are enrolled in school in NSW may be able to get assistance with travel through the Assisted School Travel Program (ASTP).

Students also need to:

Parents and carers can apply for the ASTP through their child’s school.

For more information read the Assisted School Travel Program Guidelines.
who_can_apply: School students living with disability who are enrolled in school in NSW.
what_you_need: Parents and carers must apply for the ASTP through their child’s school.
